fixed_anchor: Combined spectrum/CDF/d1/d2, physical top2 only;64 independent balanced ExtraTrees, leaf1,sqrt; three fixed seeds, never choose best seed
old_outer: exact old99 GroupKFold assignment; deterministic geometry-hash folds for additions; no depth selection
fixed_inner: old training-group assignment preserved, additions hash-assigned; thresholds0.5, old-baseline transferred, and training-only retuned reported separately
compact_inner: 3 GroupKFold within each outer training fold; training-only feature, model, thresholds and StandardScaler
paired_reference: CuAu->clean CuAu; Cu100->actual supplied clean Cu100 raw electronic spectra locally convolved; same-model conditional inference, no independently proved parent/experimental transfer
coverage: CO-only; N(CO)/all surface metal sites, different from Cu-normalized loading; no counts/metadata in predictors
unsupported_chemistry: retained audited records but excluded from closed11-label fitting; see training_exclusions
one_clean_CuAu_negative: kept to preserve historical99 comparison; new clean Cu100 is reference input, not an added adsorbate sample
not_independent_confirmation: reused configurations and folds, not a locked prospective experiment
